_comment: Single source of truth for the venue floor plan (October 19 client layout: open-style booths). Read by scripts/venue_set.py (Blender: hardware baked into the GLB) and by src/main.js plus its modules (interaction, collision, minimap, live graphics). Coordinates are three.js world metres: x east, z = -(Blender y), y up. The stage is at the north end (most negative z); the main entrance is on the south wall at z = 0. Sizes are deliberately a little more generous than the real room so the digital hall is comfortable to walk.

hall._comment: The authoring .blend is a 19.35 x 25.15 m hall with a 3.5 m ceiling. The build stretches every vertex north of stretchFromZ by stretchBy (keeping the chamfered stage-end corners and every door where they were) and lifts every vertex above ceilingFrom by ceilingBy.
hall._commentEast: The foyer is widened by translating every vertex east of stretchEastFromX by stretchEastBy (only the curved east wall, the foyer floor/ceiling edges and the end of the foyer's north wall lie there); a filler closes the south wall between the last foyer door and the moved wall.

foyerEastWall._comment: The curved east wall of the foyer is an arc of this circle once widened. Used for collision.

led._comment: 16:9 LED wall standing on the back of the stage. 10.0 x 5.625 m — twice the area of the old 7 x 3.94 m screen.

seating._comment: Twenty seats on two upholstered backless benches (ten each) either side of the centre aisle, facing the stage. `pitch` is the seat spacing used for sitting.

standees._comment: Freestanding cut-outs from the stage design, placed on the hall floor either side of the stage so they never cover the LED wall.

grid._comment: Open-style booths, as in the October 19 floor plan: two islands of twelve 2.4 m square booths, back to back on a shared spine wall, separated by a 3 m alleyway that lines up with the foyer door. Each row is one colour zone. `rows[].booths` lists the official booth numbers left to right (west -> east), so moving an exhibitor is a one-line edit. `facing` is the z direction a row opens toward (-1 = north, at the stage).

graphic._comment: Printable area of one booth's back wall in the booth frame: u along the row from the booth's west edge, y up; offset is the distance of the print from the spine plane.

counter._comment: Counter in the booth frame: depth span from the spine, width, height. Centred across the booth.

foyer._comment: Pre-function foyer, adapted from the plan to the widened digital foyer. Hardware is baked by scripts/venue_set.py; sign faces and wall graphics are drawn live by src/modules/venueSignage.js.

dealCorner._comment: High cocktail tables (plan: "4 or 10") in two columns.

photoWall._comment: Curved photo wall wrapping the Youth Media Hub: an arc of a circle, angles in degrees in the x/z plane from +x toward +z. The printed face is the convex (west) side.

safeguarding._comment: Low stanchion barrier marking the safeguarding area by the south-east stairs; the safeguarding lounge itself is outside the hall.
